daily_primary_vol.bill_date: invoice/billing date stored as ISODate object — use {"$date":"YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ"} in filters
daily_primary_vol.bill_item: line item position number within the invoice
daily_primary_vol.bill_type: billing document type e.g. F2=standard invoice, credit note, debit note
daily_primary_vol.inv_qty: invoiced quantity (may differ from bill_qty for returns/adjustments)
daily_primary_vol.netval_inv: net invoice value — primary billing/revenue amount in rupees
daily_primary_vol.tax_amount: GST / tax amount on the invoice
daily_primary_vol.tcs: Tax Collected at Source amount (Indian TCS)
daily_primary_vol.dbr_code: distributor code — unique ID of the distributor/dealer
daily_primary_vol.zm_code: Zonal Manager code — use this to identify or group by Zonal Manager
daily_primary_vol.business_unit: business unit name e.g. EAST, WEST, NORTH, SOUTH, CENTRAL
daily_primary_vol.ter_code: territory code — stored as a string (e.g. '1097'); matches territory_master.territory_code which is stored as a number, cast when joining
daily_primary_vol.stor_loc: storage location code within the plant
daily_primary_vol.model_code: product model code — use for model-level sales analysis
daily_primary_vol.colour: product colour variant — case is inconsistent in stored data (e.g. 'Black' and 'BLACK' are the same value); normalize with UPPER()/$toUpper before grouping

daily_secondary_vol.secondary_date: secondary sales date — ISODate object, use {"$date":"YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ"} in filters
daily_secondary_vol.NET_VALUE: net value as string — do NOT use for SUM/aggregation, use 'value' field instead
daily_secondary_vol.value: numeric net sales value — use this for SUM and revenue calculations
daily_secondary_vol.zm_code: Zonal Manager code — use for Zonal Manager grouping and analysis
daily_secondary_vol.business_unit: business unit name e.g. EAST, WEST, NORTH, SOUTH, CENTRAL
daily_secondary_vol.ter_code: territory code — stored as a string (e.g. '4093'); matches territory_master.territory_code which is stored as a number, cast when joining
daily_secondary_vol.model_code: product model code — use for model-level sales analysis
daily_secondary_vol.colour: product colour variant — case is inconsistent in stored data (e.g. 'Black', 'BLACK', 'black' all appear); normalize with UPPER()/$toUpper before grouping
daily_secondary_vol.return: return reason code — empty string means no return
daily_secondary_vol.is_nonsl: 1 if non-sellable item, 0 if normal sellable stock

dbr_master.city: distributor's city — case is inconsistent in stored data (e.g. 'Ranchi' and 'RANCHI' both occur for the same city); normalize with UPPER()/$toUpper before comparing or grouping. This is the primary field for 'distributors in <city>' questions. Multiple distributors typically share a city.
dbr_master.date: distributor join date — ISODate object, use {"$date":"YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ"} in filters
dbr_master.is_deleted: 1 if the distributor row is soft-deleted, 0 otherwise — filter to is_deleted=0 for any 'active'/'current' distributor count or list unless the user explicitly asks to include deleted ones

territory_master.dbr_code: distributor code — matches dbr_master.dbr_code (strip leading zeros from dbr_master's value first). One distributor can have MULTIPLE rows here (one per territory, sometimes duplicated) — joining to dbr_master will fan out rows, so aggregate/dedupe before summing distributor-level amounts
territory_master.territory_code: territory code — matches dbr_master.territory for the same dbr_code
territory_master.area_description: Comma-separated town/village/locality names within this territory — finer-grained than a city and NOT a reliable substitute for dbr_master.city. For 'distributors in <city>' questions use dbr_master.city instead. Only search this field when the user names a specific locality/town smaller than a city (e.g. a village name) that dbr_master.city won't contain.
